scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof is supplied. Finite numerical diagnostics do not constitute a general proof. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: One generalized Steiner step on a unit Euclidean ball only, in dimension n at least two. The normalized-volume limits are for fixed positive parameter or fixed crossover parameter; they make no claim about repeated stochastic iterations. Historical priority for equivalent half-ellipsoid formulas remains uncertain.
title: The exact John ellipsoid of a one-step generalized Steiner ball, with a singular dimension crossover
